Top-right aim: arm extended gently right, other hand supports bottle; finger over trigger. Bottom-right finish: trigger released, bottle lowered slightly, warm relieved smile toward tree. No book, no tree, no backdrop, no writing, no grid, no repeated identical poses. All cells isolated with no touching neighbors and no clipping. Crisp 2D pastel painted style exactly matching reference. This is a small game action atlas, not a scene redraw.
